description: This file contains unit tests for the NixMode resolution logic within the OpenClaw project. The tests verify the behavior of resolving the 'nixMode' configuration from a stable suite stored in UserDefaults, depending on whether the app is running as a bundle or outside.

classes.name: NixModeStableSuiteTests
classes.description: A test suite structure containing tests related to resolving 'nixMode' from a stable suite.

methods.name: resolves from stable suite for app bundles
methods.description: Tests that verifies 'nixMode' is correctly resolved from UserDefaults suite when the app is an app bundle.

methods.name: ignores stable suite outside app bundles
methods.description: Tests that verifies 'nixMode' resolution is ignored outside app bundles.
